topic.title: Habitats Regulations Assessment / Appropriate Assessment
topic.source_contract: European site and conservation objectives, plan or project identity, likely significant effects, in-combination assessment, appropriate assessment, mitigation certainty, integrity conclusion, derogation tests, decision and monitoring evidence

scope_guards: Distance from a habitats site is not proof of no likely significant effect.
Screening information is not an appropriate assessment.
Mitigation cannot be treated as delivered merely because it is proposed.
A shadow HRA is not the competent authority's assessment.
An integrity conclusion is not inferred from absence of objection.
Derogation is not available without the required sequential legal tests.
Authorisation is not treated as effective mitigation performance.
No score or promotion is written without exact assessment, decision, mitigation and monitoring evidence.
